identity: A popular-science miscellany column from an Arabic magazine: masthead line بستان المعرفة, byline line إعداد مجد الدين فهمي, then five self-contained illustrated items, each opened by its own short headline paragraph (أسماك تمشي على قدمين / أسرار الهجرة عند الطيور وراثية / ملجأ لأيتام الغوريلا والشمبانزي / معاهدة صداقة بين فرس النهر والتمساح / منازل المستقبل شمسية) and continued in short body paragraphs. Register is journalistic MSA popular science: narrative past for the anecdotes (استوردت، قفزت، وحبس العلماء)، descriptive present for the explanations (تعتبر، تنتشر، تحول)، and picture-deixis tying prose to photographs (في الصورة الأولى نرى، أما الصورة الثانية، المنزل الذي نراه في الصورة). 796 tokens, 26 <NL>.
law: Two layers. LAYER 1 (forced by format): the token before every <NL> and the final token 795 always close a sentence; <NL> never carries one. That yields 27 fixed boundaries, and it means every headline, byline and masthead line is its own unit. LAYER 2 (mine to judge): inside paragraphs, the sentence unit of this register is a full predication that opens a NEW informational move. I split at (a) discourse-resetting fronted adverbials that restart the narrative — وهنا, وعند البحث عن..., ولأن...فـ; (b) wa-/fa- plus a new finite verb that advances to a new stage or a new fact rather than coordinating inside the same event; (c) asyndetic juxtaposition of two complete predications each with its own subject. I do NOT split at subordinators (بينما، حيث، إذ، إلى أن، رغم أن، التي، مما، لـ + subjunctive), at colon-style appositions where an announcement noun (السؤال الحائر، المفاجأة) is followed by its content, at ثم inside a procedure, or at a bare verb continuing the same subject as a circumstantial haal. Calibration check: 27 forced boundaries alone give 28.5 tokens/sentence, too long for this register; the 10 internal splits give ~20.8, which is where MSA feature journalism actually sits. That the author freely opens paragraphs with و (واكتشف، والأمر، وحبس، واختيار، وفي عدد) proves wa- is sentence-initial in his hand, so wa- cannot be treated as an automatic non-boundary — it must be weighed by whether the clause moves the topic.
reasoning: Site 32 الأسواق, before ولم يخطر ببال أحد: the import clause (13-32) is complete, and ولم يخطر... is a narratorial step back with its own temporal anchor في ذلك الحين, foreshadowing the hook مفاجأة مذهلة. New subject, new move. Split, med. Site 66 المزرعة, before وهنا برز السؤال الحائر: وهنا is the strongest reset in this author's inventory. Split, hi. Site 70 الحائر, before كيف وصلت السمكتان: declined. This is the announcement-plus-content pattern; the question is the content of السؤال, i.e. a colon, not a terminal, and the question already terminates at 78 where <NL> forces a boundary. Site 54 وتم العثور عليهما: declined, because jumping and being found are one micro-event, which is exactly what distinguishes it from 32 and 248. Site 131 الكبير, before تبين امتلاكها: asyndetic, and تبين has its own subject (the masdar امتلاكها), so it is a second predication rather than a modifier of خفايا اللغز. Colon remains possible, hence med. Site 186 بغزارة, before الأنثى تضع بيضها: تتناسل بغزارة closes a complete claim; الأنثى تضع بيضها... is a fresh nominal sentence with an explicit new subject, and مما then hangs off it correctly. Split, med. Site 248 عام, before وتقرر اصطياد: the purpose clause لإثبات... has closed; وتقرر opens the second stage of the experiment. Leaving it joined makes a 46-token sentence. Split, med. Site 293 القديمة, before وهنا جاءت المفاجأة: same وهنا reset as 66. Split, hi. Site 296 المفاجأة, before الطيور الكبيرة الخبيرة: declined, for the same reason as 70. Decisive internal evidence: at 347-349 the author writes the identical move as برزت المفاجأة الثانية وهي أن..., i.e. he binds the announcement to its content with an explicit connector inside one sentence. So المفاجأة plus bare content is apposition, not a period. Site 279 ثم أطلقوها: declined, ثم chains steps of one procedure. Site 339 وأسبانيا, before وعند البحث عن أسباب هذا الاختيار: fronted circumstantial adverbial plus new verb برزت, the same shape as وهنا. This 59-token paragraph cannot be one sentence. Split, hi. Sites 328 إذ and 355 إذ: declined, subordinator. Site 484 المائية, before بينما التماسيح: declined. بينما is a contrastive subordinator; the whole paragraph is one hippo-versus-crocodile contrast. Site 489 اللحوم, before تنقض على ضحاياها: declined, and this is the test case that keeps 186 principled — تنقض is a bare verb with no explicit subject continuing التماسيح as a haal, whereas الأنثى at 187 introduces a new explicit subject. Site 567 يجف, before ولأن فرس النهر...فهو لا يرفض: a complete because-therefore construction opening after the drought clause has closed; the 68-token paragraph demands the split. Split, hi. Site 587 الطويل: declined, وتحاول is coordinated under إلى أن. Site 698 حراري, before فبسقوط أشعة الشمس: the projects sentence (667-698) is already 32 tokens and complete; فـ plus fronted بسقوط opens the physical mechanism, a new proposition with its own scope. Split, med. Site 760 الكهربائية, before فلا يحتاج: declined, and this is the counterweight that keeps 698 principled — فلا يحتاج has no expressed subject, inherits المنزل from far back, and is a tight consequence inside the ongoing حيث-chain describing the house. Site 773 المعروفة, before ويمكن للخلايا المرصوصة: the 56-token حيث-chain has run out; ويمكن opens an independent quantitative claim. Split, med. Site 736 حيث: declined, subordinator.
